title: Confirm RMS screen loads during Services Unplanned restart (before UPS-related master estop removal)
summary: Verify that the Fortna RMS web interface finishes loading the "monitor/robotControl" screen for the "Services Unplanned restart" context before proceeding with the UPS-related master estop removal step.
when_to_use: Use when performing a "Services Unplanned restart" support activity and you must confirm the Fortna RMS "monitor/robotControl" screen is fully loaded and ready before the UPS-related master estop removal step is performed.
not_for: Do not proceed to any UPS/master estop-related action if the RMS screen does not load or remains in a loading/failed state.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the RMS web check (load and readiness confirmation) for the "monitor/robotControl" screen before the UPS-related master estop removal step.
safety_notes: Stop and escalate if the RMS screen does not load or remains in a loading/failed state; do not proceed with the UPS/master estop-related action.
access_or_tools_needed: Browser access to the RMS URL path fragment shown in the source (includes "monitor/robotControl")

steps.healthy_condition: The browser is displaying the RMS "monitor/robotControl" page (not a different RMS section).
steps.failure_condition: The URL does not reach the "monitor/robotControl" screen context, or the page cannot be reached.
